# HaltOS

> HaltOS is a monochrome, terminal-style layer for Ubuntu that turns a VPS into a KDE Plasma remote desktop for Claude Code over RDP. It adds an OS identity, Plasma, Kvantum, SDDM and Plymouth themes, and claudegrid for running several Claude Code agents side by side.

Install on a fresh Ubuntu 25.04 or newer server, as root: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/halitsever/haltos/main/bootstrap.sh | sudo bash`. It installs claude-code-vps first (Plasma over RDP, hardened SSH, Docker, Claude Code), then HaltOS on top. HaltOS is not a separate distribution: `/etc/os-release` keeps `ID=ubuntu` and packages still come from Ubuntu. It needs Plasma 6, so Ubuntu 24.04 is refused.

## Docs

- [HaltOS home](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/): what HaltOS installs, the one-command install, removal and FAQ
- [KDE Plasma theme](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/kde-plasma-theme/): screenshots, what the theme changes, installing it on any Plasma 6 desktop without root, and undo
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/haltos/blob/main/Readme.md): features, install on an existing Plasma 6 machine, updates, removal and known limits
- [Testing a release](https://github.com/halitsever/haltos/blob/main/docs/testing.md): step-by-step checks on a fresh server
- [Releasing](https://github.com/halitsever/haltos/blob/main/docs/releasing.md): how versions are tagged and published

## Optional

- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/): all posts
- [How to install fastfetch on any current Ubuntu release](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/install-fastfetch-ubuntu.html): Install fastfetch on Ubuntu 24.04 with the official PPA or a .deb, and on 25.04 and later with apt. Check the version, run it at login, and remove it again.
- [Writing a fastfetch config with your own logo and colours](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/fastfetch-config.html): A fastfetch config explained line by line: where config.jsonc lives, a custom ASCII logo file with colour slots, module keys, separators and presets.
- [Installing and switching SDDM login screen themes](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/sddm-themes.html): SDDM themes explained: where they live, the files a Qt 6 theme needs, how to switch from System Settings or the terminal, test mode, and why xrdp skips them.
- [fastfetch or neofetch: the differences that matter now](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/fastfetch-vs-neofetch.html): fastfetch vs neofetch: neofetch was archived in April 2024, fastfetch is maintained, written in C and configured in JSONC. How to switch, and keep the look.
- [MOTD on Linux servers, and how to write your own](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/what-is-motd.html): What MOTD means on a Linux server, how Ubuntu builds it from /etc/update-motd.d at SSH login, how to turn off its ads and notices, and a custom banner script.
- [Changing the Plymouth boot splash on Ubuntu and Debian](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/plymouth-themes.html): How Plymouth themes work and how to change the boot splash: update-alternatives on Ubuntu, plymouth-set-default-theme on Debian, initramfs and the splash flag.
- [Why xrdp opens a different desktop, and how to theme it](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/xrdp-session-theme.html): Why an xrdp session starts XFCE or looks different from your desktop, how ~/.xsession picks the session, fixing a black screen, and applying a theme over RDP.
- [Konsole colour schemes and profiles, with a monochrome example](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/konsole-theme.html): How Konsole themes work: .colorscheme and .profile files, where they live, setting the default profile, plus the HaltMono scheme and a two-line bash prompt.
- [Run several Claude Code agents in parallel with git worktrees](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/parallel-claude-code-agents-git-worktrees.html): one worktree and branch per agent, side by side with claudegrid
- [Secure a VPS for remote development](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/secure-vps-remote-development.html): key-only SSH, ufw, unattended upgrades and RDP
- [KDE Plasma over RDP on a VPS with xrdp](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/kde-plasma-over-rdp-xrdp.html): xrdp, the X11 session and running without a display manager or GPU
- [Rebrand Ubuntu without breaking apt](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/rebrand-ubuntu-os-release-dpkg-divert.html): os-release fields and dpkg-divert
- [Generate a Kvantum theme from design tokens](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/kvantum-theme-from-design-tokens.html): building the HaltMono Kvantum SVG from a few tokens
- [Keep your dotfiles in git without leaking private files](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/dotfiles-sync-without-leaks.html): scrubbing paths, skipping binaries and a local-only list
- [Why a monochrome desktop works for AI coding](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/monochrome-desktop-for-ai-coding.html): one palette and one typeface to keep attention on agent output
- [Self-updating shell scripts without the footguns](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/safe-self-updating-shell-scripts.html): safe git-based updates that follow release tags
- [Three ways to get VS Code on Ubuntu, and the one HaltOS uses](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/install-vscode-ubuntu.html): Install VS Code on Ubuntu from Microsoft's apt repository, the .deb or the snap. The deb822 sources file, the debconf question and how updates arrive.
- [What actually differs between Kubuntu and Ubuntu](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/kubuntu-vs-ubuntu.html): Kubuntu vs Ubuntu: the same archive with KDE Plasma instead of GNOME. Plasma versions per release, kubuntu-desktop vs kde-plasma-desktop, and servers.
- [Finding shell script bugs before they run, with ShellCheck](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/shellcheck.html): How to use ShellCheck on bash and POSIX sh scripts: severity levels, -s sh, disable directives, reading the SC codes, and the CI setup HaltOS uses.
- [sh is not bash on Ubuntu: what breaks and how to tell](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/bash-vs-sh.html): bash vs sh on Ubuntu: /bin/sh is dash, so bash-only syntax fails under sh. Real dash errors, the common bashisms, shebangs, and finding them with ShellCheck.
- [Scheduling a daily job with a systemd timer instead of cron](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/systemd-timer.html): How a systemd timer works next to its service: OnCalendar vs OnBootSec, RandomizedDelaySec, Persistent, list-timers, and a real timer from a HaltOS server.
- [Adding a font on Ubuntu so every app can use it](https://projects.halit.org/haltos/blog/install-fonts-ubuntu.html): How font installation works on Ubuntu: apt font packages, ~/.local/share/fonts for one user, fc-cache and fc-list, with JetBrains Mono as the example.
- [Source](https://github.com/halitsever/haltos): repository
- [claude-code-vps](https://github.com/halitsever/claude-code-vps): the server setup HaltOS installs on top of
